I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; the draft still needs someone to send it.

The draft goes to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the $2,101 per-seat rate as Marcus provided it and says Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis.

Hollis isn't Anselm, June or the account owner, so he'd normally need approval to get a rate. Anselm is CFO and can approve finance figures, so his message counts as that approval. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth didn't need to approve it. I found no files for a Thornbury account in the share, so I used the figure exactly as Anselm stated it.
